output_encoding.description: Decode stage that produced the tool output (GAP-ENCODING-GATE, OPS-PROTOCOL §8): utf-8 / utf-8-sig / gb18030 / utf-8-lossy, comma-joined for multi-chunk streams.

candidate_count.description: FUS-RETRIEVAL-MECH P0-B step 2/4 (2026-08-14): the per-activation deduplicated candidate count after this call (or at refusal), shared by the web_fetch family and browser_read (local_browser second segment). Present only on candidate-counted tool_completed events; pairing/range/error-shape rules are enforced by the Python cross-layer verifier (_verify_v02_candidate_count), keeping the schema shape minimal.

candidate_cap.description: FUS-RETRIEVAL-MECH P0-B step 2/4 (2026-08-14): the candidate cap in effect (ORZ_WEB_FETCH_CANDIDATE_CAP, default 8), shared by web_fetch and browser_read. Present together with candidate_count.

inject_tokens_used.description: ORZ-CACHE-CONTEXT-COST (2026-08-15, ADR-0010 §3.6): the accumulated estimated tokens of this model round's injected tool results at the refusal (round_inject_budget_exceeded). Present together with inject_tokens_budget.

inject_tokens_budget.description: ORZ-CACHE-CONTEXT-COST (2026-08-15, ADR-0010 §3.6): the per-round injection budget in effect (ORZ_MAX_INJECT_TOKENS_PER_ROUND, default 50K). Present together with inject_tokens_used.

source.description: P0-C S3 前置 (2026-08-15, P1-2 定案): the refusing gate family — permission bridge / ACAF ticket gate / retrieval mode gate / taint (reserved).

policy_denial.description: P0-C S3 前置 (2026-08-15, P1-2 定案): structured policy denial carried by a refusal completion — controller-side no-ToolStarted refusals (ACAF ticket gate / retrieval mode gates) or a host-level structured denial on a ToolStarted+ToolCompleted (permission denials from the built-in bridge stay event-less by audit contract). Every policy_denial completion must be self-describing: status=error, non-zero exit_code and the tool must belong to the known refusal path for the source — enforced by the Python verifier (_verify_v02_policy_denial), keeping the schema shape minimal.

console_mode.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): present exactly when the completion belongs to a direct-mode model action (audited fallback) — the event chain correlates to the console_mode_transition via transition_id.

transition_id.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): the console → direct transition this completion belongs to (present together with console_mode).

trace_id.description: PLAN-FIRST 阶段 C (2026-08-16, ADR-0010 §14.17⑱): the console trace id of the direct action (call_id) — console_step_done evidence requires a trace_id corresponding to an already-occurred ToolCompleted.
